{"notes": "Visit 3 (left 5:00). I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting no one with specific placements. The chain looks closed and dark all the way round with no visible break. One pale domino is still at about (20.3, 7.8) by the dip on the top line. The belly near x 23-26 still looks crowded or doubled, so I still need to check it. The wording at 4:15 suggests everyone has stopped touching, so any stray or double line will probably stay in for the push.

SOFIA: Not seen or heard this visit. Jack says she and Hana built the tail, but that is his claim, not something I saw. Earlier evidence still stands: a clear plan, good coordination, and a commitment to inspect the join. I still haven't confirmed that she inspected it or what she did about the crowded belly. Strong collaboration so far.

OMAR: Not seen this visit. Earlier he showed good ownership and communication. The pale stray at the dip is still there, so his cleanup was not completed. I don't know whether he chose to leave it.

HANA: She called for hands off and said it looks solid, which is a sensible, team-minded close. Jack credits her with the tail, but I can't verify that. Execution is still unproven by my own observation. Ask her what she built.

JACK: He gave generous credit to teammates and followed the hands-off call, which is good collaboration. His praise is not evidence of what he built. I still have no evidence he patched anything. Ask him privately what he did.

NEXT: Watch the fall test. Check where it breaks, especially near the dip and the belly at x 23-26. Ask Hana and Jack privately what they built."}
